answer_1.quote: this study introduces Synth-SBDH, a novel synthetic SBDH dataset that mimics EHR notes.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic clinical notes with SBDH annotations

answer_2.quote: We report both micro and macro F scores for all experiments. For NER and DSS, we report scores following exact matching criteria.

answer_3.quote: we also conducted LLM evaluation by prompting GPT-4, resulting in a 90.78% LLM-LLM alignment.

answer_4.quote: the same group of two human experts who provided seed examples in the synthetic data generation phase assessed all test annotations and the quality of the provided rationales.
answer_4.guideline: Experts considered each GPT-4 generated annotation for one of these actions - keep it when the annotation is correct, update it when there is an error, or discard it if the annotation was unnecessary or erroneous. Additionally, the experts were instructed to add missing annotations.
